from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PermitVolatilityPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single data point extracted from one document's Table 1a."""
    report_date: str = Field(description="The release date of the report (YYYY-MM)")
    period_month: str = Field(description="The month the volatility change refers to (YYYY-MM)")
    category: Literal["single-family units", "buildings with five or more units"] = Field(description="The permit category")
    pct_change: float = Field(description="Month-over-month percentage change value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    volatility_points: list[PermitVolatilityPoint]
